notice_unmatched_title: Booking from someone not in your leads
notice_unmatched_body: {name} booked {event} for {when}. No lead has this email, so nothing was created. Add the lead if they are a prospect.
notice_cancelledUnmatched_title: A booking from an unknown email was cancelled
calendly_help: Paste a Calendly personal access token and a signing key (any long random string). Bookings and cancellations then arrive as tasks and notifications.
calcom_help: Paste a Cal.com API key and a webhook secret (any long random string). Bookings and cancellations then arrive as tasks and notifications.
state_not_subscribed: Not subscribed yet. Press Subscribe to start receiving bookings.
state_subscribed: Subscribed. New bookings and cancellations arrive automatically.
state_needs_paid_plan: Calendly only sends webhooks on a paid plan. Upgrade the Calendly account, then subscribe again.
state_user_scope: Subscribed for this Calendly user only. Bookings of other team members are not received unless an organisation admin subscribes.
state_needs_attention: The token was refused. Reconnect with a new one.
state_error: Could not subscribe right now. Try again in a few minutes.
webhookHelp: If you cannot subscribe from here, add this URL as a webhook for invitee created and cancelled (Calendly) or booking created, cancelled and rescheduled (Cal.com), with the same signing secret.
